name: Granite Cheek
description: Hatchet held at the sternum with the elbow bent, ready to meet a cut from any side.

name: Bitassault
description: A chop followed by an instant return to guard leaves no opening in the swing.

name: Rumblekerf
description: The beard hooks an arm as the user steps past, tearing the opponent's stance open.

name: Toespurt
description: Slipping a half pace outside the opponent's lead foot, the user gains an angle on the flank.

name: Beardassault
description: Qi from the full meridians flows into one deep chop that carries through a defending arm.

name: Hoarfrost Toe
description: Hooked behind the elbow, the arm is wrenched with qi until the opponent's weapon drops.

name: Glintbit
description: A qi-sharpened chop punches through mail and padding to bite the flesh beneath.

name: Successive Poll
description: Three chops in three paces drive the opponent backward, each cut opening the line for the next.

name: Iron Eye
description: Elbows at the ribs and the head forward, the user covers the whole front against close attack.

name: Helvethrash
description: The beard lifts the opponent's elbow just far enough for a straight cut to slip beneath it.

name: Might Axehew
description: A chop, a short drag across the wound and a second chop are strung into one unbroken motion.

name: Surging Splinter
description: Turning on the heel, the user slides inside the opponent's reach and out of their weapon's line.

name: Chime Billet
description: Qi along the beard bites deep when it hooks, so the tug rips the opponent's guard loose.

name: Chockbarrage
description: Qi passes from the first cut into the second without a pause, so both land at full strength.

name: Thornpoll
description: The hook slides down a held haft to the hand and wrenches the fingers open.

name: Hour Chock
description: A hook to the guard arm, a qi-charged pull and a chop to the exposed ribs unmake a defence in one sequence.

name: Axehew Hauberk
description: Pulling the weapon arm over with the hook, the user turns the opponent off their feet and chops down.

name: Adamant Haftswell
description: A quiet stance with qi pooled in the palm lets the field settle along the hatchet before the first exchange.

name: Cheekthrash
description: Reversing the head mid-swing, the poll leads to stun and the edge follows to cut.

name: Silencing Fell
description: A tap along the path of the field leaves a faint numbness in the opponent's striking hand.

name: Silt Helve
description: Two smooth paces, the hatchet trailing like a pendulum, bring the user to the opponent's open side.

name: Tempered Poll
description: The beard rakes down the opponent's forearm, tearing sleeve and skin.

name: Billetbarrage
description: The qi field sharpens the edge, so the cut bites deeper than steel alone could manage.

name: Eyecloak
description: Qi pulsing through the poll bursts against a held guard and knocks the opponent's arm wide.

name: Torrent Bit
description: The qi field draws the user's weight forward, making one stride cover the ground of two.

name: Ravaging Slag Helve
description: Qi released along a sweeping cut spreads across the user's front and strikes everything within hatchet reach.

name: Resilient Toe
description: Sensing the line of a cut through the field, the user turns it with the poll and answers at once.

name: Pollassault
description: The bit sinks into the planked face of a shield and holds there for a breath.

name: Gusteye
description: A chop on a shield edge scatters splinters toward the opponent's eyes.

name: Hardened Eye
description: Standing at a door's edge, the user holds the hatchet to cover the narrow gap.

name: Racing Fell
description: A short step hugs the edge of cover so the opponent has only a thin target.

name: Tearing Chock
description: With qi along the edge, a single chop splits a barrel stave or shield plank.

name: Toxin Poll
description: The beard catches the split wood and tears it open, widening the gap for a second blow.

name: Novabillet
description: Qi gathered for a moment at the head sends one blow through a barricade and into the man behind it.

name: Harpooning Heel
description: The cleave passes through a branch or raised weapon without slowing and knocks the arm behind it aside.

name: Aegis Beard
description: Both hatchets crossed at the chest form a single guard, each covering what the other leaves open.

name: Blaze Helve
description: Left and right hatchets fall in turn, the second chop landing as the first is lifted.

name: Toe Pounce
description: A matched pair of steps, left then right, carries the user to the opponent's guard.

name: Mayhem Cheek
description: Both beards hook the opponent's arm from either side and pull in opposing directions.

name: Fellbarrage
description: One hatchet carries a qi cut while the other feints, so the opponent defends the wrong side.

name: Equipoise Bit
description: Both hatchets turn an incoming blade aside in one mirrored sweep, and one answers immediately.

name: Ponderous Heel
description: Crossing the beards behind the opponent's weapon arm, the user locks it between the two heads.

name: Funneling Helve
description: Left, right and crossed cuts follow in unbroken rhythm, each hatchet feeding the other's next stroke.

name: Needling Fell
description: Both heads strike the same point at once from opposite angles, splitting plate or shield rim.

name: Facet Toe
description: Weight on one leg and the hatchet raised high, the user waits like a hawk on its perch.

name: Bittorment
description: Dropping from the high guard in one plunge, the hatchet falls on the opponent's crown or shoulder.

name: Staggering Cheek
description: The beard strikes like a talon, snatching a cloak or sleeve and tearing it aside.

name: Murk Haftswell
description: With both arms thrown wide, the hatchet sweeps an incoming blade out and away.

name: Vaulting Chock
description: A low, skimming step covers ground quickly while keeping the head level.

name: Ironfell
description: The chop lands and the user springs straight back, leaving the opponent's counter nothing to hit.

name: Kerfassault
description: Qi gathers in the descending arm so the chop arrives faster than its wind-up suggests.

name: Compressing Beard
description: The beard clamps on a wrist and drags it down, pinning it as a hawk pins prey.

name: Hastening Heel
description: Three beats of quick backward hops carry the user out of range, lightened by qi in the legs.

name: Tiered Chock
description: A dive, a talon hook and a rising backhand chop are chained into a single falling and returning flight.

name: Perceptive Cheek
description: The qi field reads the opponent's weight shift, and the cut lands exactly where the balance breaks.

name: Annealed Poll
description: Feet set along the rim of a rutted road, the user braces the hatchet across the body.

name: Cheekbarrage
description: A downward chop aimed at the lower foot of an opponent on a sloping bank.

name: Rumble Helve
description: In a lane too tight to swing, the beard hooks a shoulder strap and twists.

name: Beard Sprint
description: Heel to toe along a narrow earthwork, the user advances without losing balance.

name: Heelthrash
description: A cut thrown from the lip of a ditch drives the qi down into the opponent's guard arm.

name: Gyve Fell
description: The beard hooks behind the knee and qi-driven pull folds the leg, dropping the opponent into the ditch.

name: Intertwined Axehew
description: Cut, hook and shove follow in order along a bank, each move pressing the opponent closer to the water.

name: Fastening Beard
description: The beard pulls the leading arm while the poll strikes the chest, tipping the opponent off the bank.

name: Charter Heel
description: Each pace tests the footing before the weight is committed, with the hatchet held steady before the body.

name: Skinning Axehew
description: Hopping from one foot to the next like a ford crossing, the user chops on the landing.

name: Chimebit
description: Light repeated taps spread like ripples along the opponent's raised weapon, unsettling the grip.

name: Gust Cheek
description: Letting an attack's own force carry the body sideways, the user slides out of its path.

name: Hamstringing Toe
description: The beard circles an extended arm in a small eddy and wrenches it out of line.

name: Helvetorment
description: At the crossing step qi floods the edge and the cut falls with the weight of the whole stride.

name: Thorn Eye
description: A steady qi-backed pull on the hooked arm drags the opponent low, like an undertow at the ankle.

name: Careening Poll
description: Backing along an imagined shoal, the user keeps solid ground beneath every step.

name: Slagfell
description: After a moment of gathering, one broad cut releases qi across the whole front like a flood cresting.

name: Alternating Handlenub
description: Each step, hook and cut is counted in the mind and joined into one measured crossing of the opponent's guard.

name: Enduring Beard
description: The hatchet hangs loose at the hip like a sail slack, ready to snap up when the wind rises.

name: Cheektorment
description: A sudden short chop comes with no wind-up at all, like a gust across a still field.

name: Silencing Heel
description: A loose wrist flicks the poll against the opponent's grip, rattling the weapon in their hand.

name: Bounding Toe
description: Turning like a leaf on the wind, the user drifts past the opponent's lunge.

name: Grinding Handlenub
description: Qi rises with the arm in a backhand that lifts the opponent's guard before the edge arrives.

name: Murk Beard
description: A sideways sweep of the head meets a blade from the flank and pushes it across and away.

name: Hoarfrost Chock
description: The beard snags a sleeve and qi-fed motion drags the opponent along like a leaf in a gale.

name: Compounding Bit
description: Chops arrive from shifting angles in quick succession, each seeming to come from a different quarter of the wind.

name: Transfixing Facet Eye
description: One concentrated chop bursts through a raised guard like a squall tearing through a sail.

name: Unbroken Heel
description: Standing square to a sworn bearing, the user holds the hatchet before the body without wavering.

name: Severing Poll
description: The chop falls along the line already taken, never straying from the bearing the eyes have fixed.

name: Paralyzing Bit
description: A rap along the opponent's blade line tests it and nudges it from its true path.

name: Torrent Eye
description: The parry turns the blade while the user's feet and shoulders stay locked on the bearing.

name: Billet Jaunt
description: A silent, even pace along the bearing closes the gap without disturbing the guard.

name: Crippling Beard
description: As an oath is spoken to oneself, the beard hooks the wrist and holds it fast.

name: Ironhelve
description: Qi flows straight along the held bearing, so the cut lands without wasted motion.

name: Dominating Kerf
description: The hook pulls the opponent along the user's bearing, dragging their stance out of its own.

name: Axehew Canter
description: One qi-lightened step along the bearing, taken with no turn of the shoulders, shifts the user a full stride.

name: Unmaking Cheek
description: A hook that holds the arm and a chop that follows it are one oath kept in two motions.

name: Doctrine Poll
description: Without a single step off the line, hook, chop and shove follow one another to break a guard.

name: Sanguine Toe
description: After a held breath that gathers qi along the bearing, the cleave falls with the pent weight of the wind.

name: Staunch Cheek
description: Toes gripping the ground near a drop, the user braces the hatchet against any push.

name: Drubbing Beard
description: With nothing around to snag the swing, a full free chop is thrown from the shoulder.

name: Quelling Poll
description: Timing the beard's hook to a gust, the user snatches an opponent's cloak and spoils their balance.

name: Blurring Heel
description: Dropping one foot down a step in the ground, the user lowers the body below an incoming cut.

name: Billetassault
description: Qi rides the headwind along the hatchet's edge, giving the cut extra bite against the breeze.

name: Chimeeye
description: A qi-driven shove with the poll sends the opponent stumbling toward the edge of the footing.

name: Hour Helve
description: Walking the rim, the user chains cut, hook and shove so every blow pushes the opponent outward.

name: Compressing Fell
description: Hooking the leading leg and striking the chest together, the user overturns the opponent toward the drop.

name: Hardened Poll
description: A straight line is drawn in the mind from foot to target, and the hatchet guards along it.

name: Scything Chock
description: The chop is a single straight stroke, long and unhurried, as a line drawn in sand.

name: Mayhemtoe
description: A rap delivered from behind the opponent's turning shoulder pushes them further than they meant to go.

name: Vaulting Billet
description: A lateral step with the wind at the shoulder takes the user off the line of attack.

name: Gyve Cheek
description: The beard catches the opponent's weapon arm along its own line and holds it there.

name: Raging Fell
description: A second cut joins the first along the same line, qi passing between them without a gap.

name: Chime Heel
description: The parry crosses the opponent's line at an angle and bends it harmlessly toward the outside.

name: Whipping Kerf
description: Stepping back with qi in the heels, the user draws away as if borne on a wind from behind.

name: Scorching Blaze Poll
description: A web of crossing cuts, laid down quickly after a brief gathering, covers the whole front with qi.

name: Successive Toe
description: One long drawn line of step, hook and chop runs on without a pause until the guard gives.
